बारिश आई The Rain Came Hindi Grade 1-2 P

detail: UKG child landed on a 'Grade 1-2' text, made for children who already read.
On the reading page nothing was said out loud, and the written instructions (English) are not something this child can read.
Buddy talked for over 12 s in one go before the child could read.
2 word(s) the child said were not heard because Buddy was talking or the session was paused.
Wanted Buddy to read the line again, but there is no button for that while reading ('Listen first' is switched off during a session).
Tapped the big microphone to talk; the session paused instead.
Buddy started talking 2.7 s into a planned 2.56 s thinking pause.
Buddy started talking 2.3 s into a planned 3.54 s thinking pause.
